decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation was launched only in 2023, so its value is still uncertain, and it builds on existing laser technology at low carrying cost, which keeps the option worth holding even though it gets only a website mention rather than its own page.
The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core offer, has a dedicated page, and drives recurring consumables revenue, so keeping it costs little while its prospects are still unfolding.

The piezo inkjet printer is near the established business, presented on its own page, and fits the firm's strategy of matching technologies to surfaces, and no evidence yet shows its value will fail to materialize.
